packageRules.description: gh-aw generates these lock files and pins their actions itself. Bump the actions in the .md sources and gh-aw itself by hand, then recompile with `gh aw compile`.
This repository loads its own orb from master on purpose, so never pin it to a digest.
Override :pinDevDependencies for packages that are used as both a dev and non-dev dependency, so they are not pinned.

tsdown >=0.23.5 needs the TypeScript 7.1 API for tsgo. Its 7.0 fallback needs `typescript` to be 7.0, and here it is TypeScript 6. rolldown must match tsdown, and @typescript/native joins so that its 7.1 bump lands in the same PR. That PR fails until build-new uses `tsgo.moduleUrl`, so it stays open as the reminder.
The extractor needs the TypeScript 7.1 API (`typescript/sync`). Skip 7.0.x, so that the first 7.x PR opens when 7.1.0 is released.
prBodyNotes: Do not merge as is. First port the extractor to `typescript/sync`: https://github.com/mui/mui-public/issues/2129
